description: Search ProductGuru's published products and official recall notices. Pass a barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A) to get that product and any recall notice linked to it, or words (e.g. 'power bank') to search product names. Returns at most 10 results, each with an id, title and URL; pass an id to fetch for the full factual record. Ids are 'p:<ean>' (product) or 'r:<recall>' (recall notice). Medicines are not covered.

query.description: A barcode (8, 12 or 13 digits) or a few words naming a product.
